Method.name: AddToSvn
Method.Implementation: set stat = 0 Set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: " _ fullPath _ " svn info:" _ stat) If stat '= 0 { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _" returned no information, add to SVN" ) Set cmd = $$$SVNADD _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn add:" _ stat) } if ((stat = 0) && (commit = 1)) { Set cmd = $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' -m ""Initialization"" " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn commit:" _ stat) } Quit stat

Method.name: GetFilesInSvn
Method.Description: Get files that are checked-in to SVN
Method.Implementation:
set fullPath = $$$USRBASEDIR _ usrNm _ $$$SVNSRCTRUNK _ "cls" set tempFile = $$$USRBASEDIR _ usrNm _ "/tempSvnList" set incPath = $$$USRBASEDIR _ usrNm _ $$$SVNSRCTRUNK _ "inc" set lookupPath = $$$USRBASEDIR _ usrNm _ $$$SVNSRCTRUNK _"lookupTables"
Set cmd = $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetFilesInSvn: " _ $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " for " _ fullPath _": "_stat)
Set cmd = $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ incPath Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetFilesInSvn: " _ $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " for " _ incPath _": " _ stat)
Set cmd = $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ lookupPath Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetFilesInSvn: " _ $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " for " _ lookupPath _ ": " _ stat)
Do ..WriteToFile(tempFile, "PATH=" _ fullPath) Set cmd = $$$SVNLIST _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath _ " >> " _ tempFile Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNLIST _ " for " _ fullPath _ " : " _ stat)
Do ..WriteToFile(tempFile, "PATH=" _ incPath) Set cmd = $$$SVNLIST _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ incPath _ " >> " _ tempFile Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNLIST _ "for " _ incPath _" : " _ stat)
Do ..WriteToFile(tempFile, "PATH=" _ lookupPath) Set cmd = $$$SVNLIST _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ lookupPath _ " >> " _ tempFile Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.ItfSrcCtrlUtil).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNLIST _ "for " _ lookupPath _" : " _ stat)

set itNum = 0 set prodNm = ##class(Ens.Director).GetActiveProductionName() If prodNm = "" { set itNum = ..GetItemsFromDictionary(usrNm, passwd, nmSp, "IHC") } else { set itNum = ..GetItemsFromProduction(usrNm, passwd, nmSp) set itNum = itNum + ..GetItemsFromDictionary(usrNm, passwd, nmSp, "IHC", 1) } Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("getAllEnsembleItems: 1. set itNum = itNum + ..GetLookupFiles(nmSp, usrNm) set itNum = itNum + ..GetTasks(nmSp, usrNm)

Method.Implementation:
#dim tStat as %Status set itNum = 0 NEW $NAMESPACE SET $NAMESPACE = nmSp
&sql(Declare Cl Cursor for SELECT DISTINCT TableName into tb FROM Ens_Util.LookupTable) Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN Cl)
WHILE(SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH Cl) Quit:SQLCODE set intNm = $NAMESPACE _ "." _ tb _ ".LOOKUP" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: " _ intNm _ " in namespace: " _ $NAMESPACE) set stat = ..AddToSourceControl(intNm, usrNm, nmSp, 0) if ( stat '= $$$OK) { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: returned error") return 0 }
Set svnFile = ..ExternalName(intNm, usrNm) if (svnFile '= "") { set itNum = itNum + 1 } } &sql(CLOSE Cl)
return itNum
